verses.1: Let us also cooperate and ask that you not waste God’s gift in vain.
verses.2: He says: “Now is the time for you to listen to Him; now is the day of your salvation. Now is the right time to accept His help. Now is the day of salvation.”
verses.3: Without giving any gifts in any place, so that the service done there won’t be wasted.
verses.4: But in every situation, they present themselves as God’s servants. In many situations—whether in patience, sorrow, need, or hardship—they remain God’s servants.
verses.5: In wounds, in prisons, in chaotic situations, in places of suffering, during fasting periods.
verses.6: In honesty, in knowledge, with patience, in usefulness, with the spirit of holiness, with undying love.
verses.7: In the truth of words, in the power of God. Through the weapons of justice on the right and left sides.
verses.8: For fame and respect, for disapproval and praise as well. As both lies and truths.
verses.9: As if we were ignorant and unaware; as if we were dying and yet still alive; as if we were being educated and not dying.
verses.10: They always seem to be happy, yet they are also poor; they seem to be rich, but in reality they have nothing and possess everything.
verses.11: Our mouths will turn towards you, Corinthians. Our hearts are filled with joy.
verses.12: Do not stay in our midst; rather, stay among those who are among your own kind.
verses.13: And that same disincentive, I say, you also increased it for your sons.
verses.14: Do not become divided into two groups of people. Who can truly claim justice and fairness? Or who can truly enjoy the light in contrast to darkness?
verses.15: But which of Christ’s agreements with Belial is true, or which part of His teachings can be trusted after disbelief?
verses.16: But what kind of agreement can there be with God when we are in His image? After all, we are indeed images of God while we are alive. As God said, “I will dwell among them and walk among them.” I will become their God, and they will become my people.
verses.17: Therefore, they were removed from among them. They were punished, said the Lord. Do not be deceived by their actions; I will watch over you.
verses.18: And I will be your father, and you shall be my sons and daughters, says the Lord Almighty.
